user_query:
Please provide the gap between HOMO and LUMO of this molecule.

Input: [N][=C][C][=C][C][C][C][=Branch1][C][=O][N][Ring1][Branch2][Ring1][Branch1]

Please analyze this chemical task and provide a clear, precise answer.

problem_meta.instruction: Please provide the gap between HOMO and LUMO of this molecule.
problem_meta.agent_answer:
The input is a SELFIES string that decodes to:

`N=C1C=CC2CC(=O)N12`

Reported quantum-chemical orbital energies:

- HOMO: \(-0.2516\ \text{Ha}\)
- LUMO: \(-0.0479\ \text{Ha}\)

Therefore:

\[
\Delta E_{\mathrm{HOMO-LUMO}}
= E_{\mathrm{LUMO}}-E_{\mathrm{HOMO}}
= (-0.0479)-(-0.2516)
= \boxed{0.2037\ \text{Ha}}
\]

This is a QM9 computed value, not an experimental measurement.
